settings.heading: Get the size right first time
settings.text: Too small and they hang off the edge. Too big and a nervous dog feels exposed. Two minutes with a tape measure fixes both.

settings.title: Curlers can size down
settings.text: Pets who sleep in a tight ball like a bed that holds them. Measure them curled up and add 10cm.

settings.title: Sprawlers should size up
settings.text: If they sleep flat out, measure nose to tail stretched and add the full 20cm, or go up a size.

settings.title: Bolsters take up room
settings.text: On bolstered beds, compare their length with the inner sleeping area, not the outside size.

settings.title: Growing puppy?
settings.text: Buy for their adult size. A too-big bed is easily made cosy with a blanket; a too-small one can't be fixed.
